carrier_contract.cookie_name_rationale: Distinct from the Supabase Auth cookie (lib/supabase/server.ts), namespaced to avoid collision with any third-party cookie.
carrier_contract.path_scope_measurement: FUTURE_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED in both authority artifacts, resolved here. Measured at implementation: every route this carrier has legitimate business reaching — app/(authenticated)/app/onboarding (pre-organization), app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select (pre-organization, this batch), and the whole organization-gated workspace app/app/** — is served under the single URL prefix /app (route groups are stripped from the URL). app/admin/** is a SEPARATE top-level tree served at /admin and has no business receiving this cookie. /app is therefore the narrowest Path that reaches every legitimate reader without also reaching /login, /admin, /auth or the marketing site.
carrier_contract.session_scope: No Max-Age/Expires set — cookie dies with the browser session. Never written to a users column, a preference table, localStorage or sessionStorage. A new session (fresh cookie jar) starts with no selection — proven in tests/tenancy/s2-selected-org-carrier.test.ts 'session-only lifetime (NS2-2)'.
carrier_contract.payload: A single organization id (UUID), and nothing else. No CommercialAccount identifier, no role, no permission payload. The stored value is a bare string, never a JSON envelope — proven in 'exact payload: organization id only'.
carrier_contract.trust_model: THE CARRIER IS AN ASSERTION, NEVER A GRANT — stated verbatim in the module header of lib/auth/selected-organization.ts. The module performs no membership check of its own; the selection action is responsible for proving membership before writing.

selection_authorization.mechanism: app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select/actions.ts selectOrganizationAction reads the caller's identity via requireAuth() and the caller's active membership via getCurrentMembership() — both EXISTING sources from lib/auth/session.ts, unmodified by this batch. No new membership table, view or query is introduced.
selection_authorization.refusal_rule: Refuses (redirect with an error, never a silent fallback) when: no organizationId is supplied; the caller has no active membership at all; or the caller's active membership names a DIFFERENT organization than the one requested. No fallback to the caller's own membership on refusal — the carrier is left exactly as it was.
selection_authorization.no_inferred_default: The page (app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select/page.tsx) presents the caller's membership for an EXPLICIT selection; it never writes the carrier itself. Proven by 'no autoselection (NS2-5)': rendering the page with exactly one selectable membership does not call setSelectedOrganization.
selection_authorization.no_shape_only_check: A UUID-shaped organization id belonging to no membership of the caller is refused exactly like a malformed one — proven by 'invalid / non-member rejection' (four distinct cases: wrong org, no membership, missing id, and — NS2-6 — a super admin gets no exemption from the same check).
selection_authorization.superadmin_not_exempt: NS2-6, proven directly: a super admin principal with no membership anywhere is refused identically to an ordinary user.
